scenarios.title: Mahatma Mandir → MSI Service Center, Bodakdev
scenarios.pitch: The flagship demo: a newcomer at the hackathon venue plans a cross-city journey to a Bodakdev service center — metro with one interchange, then BRTS last mile.

expect.route: Yellow Line → Red Line at Motera → Blue Line at Old High Court → exit Thaltej → BRTS to Iskon Cross Road
expect.fallbackTest: Mark Thaltej Gate 1 exit unavailable → app picks Kalupur BRTS or walk alternative

scenarios.title: Ahmedabad Railway Station → Gujarat University
scenarios.pitch: Newcomer lands at Kalupur railway station and needs the university: one-seat Blue Line ride with the correct exit gate.

expect.route: Blue Line direct, exit Gate 1 at Gujarat University
expect.fallbackTest: Mark Kalupur Gate 2 unavailable → app routes via Gate 1/3

scenarios.title: Airport → Gandhinagar (Mahatma Mandir)
scenarios.pitch: Airport has no metro station yet — the app honestly routes metro to the nearest practical point then auto for the last leg, exactly like a real journey planner.

expect.route: Auto to Motera Stadium → Yellow Line to Mahatma Mandir

scenarios.title: APMC → Civil Hospital
scenarios.pitch: Red Line north + Blue Line east with a BRTS last mile into the hospital campus.

expect.route: Red Line → Old High Court → Blue Line → Kalupur → BRTS to Civil Hospital stop
expect.fallbackTest: Mark BRTS unavailable → app shows walk/auto fallback

scenarios.title: Destination with an unavailable exit
scenarios.pitch: Operator marks Thaltej Gate 1 unavailable (lift failure). The app re-routes via BRTS instead of a long walk, explaining why.

scenarios.title: Metro + BRTS connection demo
scenarios.pitch: Civil Hospital via Kalupur BRTS demonstrates multimodal last-mile with exact stop names.
